span.label: mechanisms
span.term: each style controls exactly one convolution: AdaIN normalises the channel to zero mean and unit variance first, so the incoming style's scale and bias do not depend on the previous statistics and are overridden by the next AdaIN
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: style localisation is trained for, not only architected: a percentage of images are generated from two latent codes with a crossover point, which stops the network assuming adjacent styles are correlated
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the paper's reason - that a traditional generator must otherwise invent spatially-varying pseudorandom numbers from earlier activations - is the preceding paragraph, not this span
span.term: stochastic detail is supplied by the architecture: per-pixel noise is added after each convolution
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the division of labour between style and noise is enforced by the discriminator rather than by design: using noise for a global property would produce spatially inconsistent decisions and be penalised
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the intermediate latent space is defined by what it is NOT required to do - it need not follow the training data's density, which is the constraint the paper blames for entanglement in the input space
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the second adjustment - dividing by epsilon squared because the perceptual distance is quadratic - is a separate sentence far down the section; a span reaching it crosses a footnote, Table 3 and a figure caption
span.term: the path length is defined as a limit under infinitely fine subdivision and computed as an approximation with a small finite epsilon instead
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the conditional entropy and its exponentiation into the final score are described in the sentences after this span
span.term: separability is measured without an encoder: auxiliary attribute classifiers label generated images, the least confident half is discarded, and a linear SVM is fitted per attribute on the latent-space points
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the input latent space, constrained to follow the training-data density, has some unavoidable entanglement
span.note: what this limits: any disentanglement claim about the input latent space: THE INPUT LATENT SPACE MUST FOLLOW THE PROBABILITY DENSITY OF THE TRAINING DATA, AND WE ARGUE THAT THIS LEADS TO SOME DEGREE OF UNAVOIDABLE ENTANGLEMENT
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The perceptual path length measurement is admitted to be biased in favour of the input latent space Z.
span.note: what this limits: the perceptual path length comparison, biased against the paper's own conclusion: THIS MEASUREMENT IS IN FACT SLIGHTLY BIASED IN FAVOR OF THE INPUT LATENT SPACE Z
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Continued FID improvement during training comes at the cost of a more entangled representation (rising path lengths).
span.note: what this limits: any use of FID as the training objective: THE SLOWLY RISING PATH LENGTHS INDICATE THAT THE IMPROVEMENTS IN FID COME AT THE COST OF A MORE ENTANGLED REPRESENTATION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The new FFHQ face dataset was crawled from Flickr and therefore inherits that site's biases.
span.note: what this limits: every result and every model trained on FFHQ: the images were crawled from Flickr, THUS INHERITING ALL THE BIASES OF THAT WEBSITE, then automatically aligned and cropped
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The central term has no agreed definition and the paper proceeds on a shared goal instead.
span.note: what this limits: any disentanglement claim made here: the paper states there are various definitions of disentanglement and adopts a common goal - a latent space of linear subspaces each controlling one factor of variation - rather than one of them
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The two metrics reported are new because the existing ones cannot be run here, so the numbers compare to nobody.
span.note: what this limits: the disentanglement figures given here: the authors state the previously proposed metrics require an encoder network mapping images to latent codes, which this architecture does not have, so the two metrics used are new ones of their own
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The perceptual distance the headline metric is built on is another network's embedding, fitted to human ratings.
span.note: what this limits: the perceptual path length reported here: it is built on a pairwise image distance computed as a weighted difference between two VGG16 embeddings, with the weights fitted so the metric agrees with human perceptual similarity judgments
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The mechanism claimed for the improvement is posited rather than shown.
span.note: what this limits: the explanation offered for why this generator disentangles: the authors posit that there is pressure on the generator because generating realistic images should be easier from a disentangled representation than from an entangled one
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: What the paper controls under the name 'style' includes the pose and the shape of the face.
span.note: what this limits: any reading of this model's 'style' as a manner of depiction: copying the coarse-resolution styles transfers pose, general hair style, face shape and eyeglasses, which are properties of the subject rather than of the manner
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the style-transfer idea of separating content from style, taken from that literature and built into the generator architecture so that style is injected at each convolution layer - the network is named after it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: an ablation table beginning from a Progressive GAN baseline, with each row adding one change to the row above
span.note: eliminates: attributing the improvement to the architecture as a whole - a table where every row differs from the previous one by a single change is what makes any single change attributable
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: 'style' - REUSED BY THE AUTHORS' OWN DECISION, FOR ARCHITECTURAL RESEMBLANCE: they say plainly that they choose to reuse the word for the vector y because similar network architectures are already used in feedforward style transfer and image-to-image translation, so the word marks a family of architectures rather than a property of a picture
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: style, once more removed - AS SPATIALLY INVARIANT STATISTICS: the paper's warrant is the style transfer literature's finding that spatially invariant statistics encode style while spatially varying features encode the instance, which is the same move gatys2015 made with a Gram matrix
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: disentanglement - A GOAL STANDING IN FOR A DEFINITION: the paper records that the literature holds various definitions and adopts the shared aim of a latent space of linear subspaces, then measures that aim with two metrics of its own devising
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: style AT COARSE RESOLUTION - POSE, FACE SHAPE AND EYEGLASSES: the styles copied from the coarse spatial resolutions carry high-level aspects of the subject itself, so at this level the word ranges over what the picture is OF and not only how it looks
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: style ON NON-FACE DATASETS - CAMERA VIEWPOINT AND CHOICE OF FURNITURE: in bedrooms the coarse styles control where the camera is and the middle styles select which furniture appears, which an art historian would call composition and subject matter rather than style
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A style-based generator (borrowing from style-transfer) drives synthesis via a mapping network + AdaIN per layer, giving automatic unsupervised separation of high-level attributes (pose/identity) from stochastic detail (freckles/hair) and scale-specific control.
